_about: Every fixture in this folder is a documented-shape fixture derived from Resend's published API, error and webhook references as they appeared in web-search snippets on 2026-10-20. None is recorded live traffic. resend.com was not reachable from the build environment (DNS refused), so no page was read first-hand; every shape is UNVERIFIED until a user-authorized live check (docs/integrations.md, Resend section). The TLS key and certificate in ../tls are test-only, self-signed for the local fake SMTP server and trusted only by the SMTP contract tests.
